title: paeonia delavayi f. trollioides
intro: Paeonia delavayi f. trollioides, commonly known as the Delavay Peony, is a plant species within the peony family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions attributed to this plant include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for stress relief and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in Paeonia delavayi f. trollioides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
